title: OrgTree Drift Engine Config (Model C)
description: Per-facet auto-remediate knobs + halt-on-critical threshold for the drift engine orchestrator. Companion to ADR-040 (drift engine) and ADR-084 §C5.

dry_run.description: Default for DriftEngine.run(); True means no writes are applied even when auto-remediation policies allow them.

halt_on_critical.description: Severity threshold. If any finding at or above this severity fires during Classify, Remediate is skipped even when dry_run=False.

facet_policies.description: Per-facet remediation knobs keyed by facet name. Facets without an entry default to all-False.

auto_remediate_value_drift.description: When True, Value Drift on this facet is auto-fixed by writing the HR value back.

auto_remediate_phantom_drift.description: When True, Phantom Drift on this facet auto-reassigns to the replaced_by successor.
